label: GitHub Year Card
description: A developer's year on GitHub on one card: the 7×53 contribution calendar with month and weekday labels and a Less→More legend, four KPI tiles (commits, pull requests, stars, top language) and the handle + year in the header. Gutterless grid with lattice-exact gaps; composes at any canvas.

year.label: Year
year.description: Calendar year (places the weeks and month labels).

contributions.label: Contributions
contributions.description: Daily contribution counts from January 1st — an array of 365/366 numbers, or one comma-separated string. Missing days count as 0.

showKpis.label: Show KPIs
showKpis.description: Show the four KPI tiles above the calendar.

preset.label: Preset
preset.description: Alpine theme: "light" (default) or "dark" — the calendar greens follow.

anim.reduceMotion.label: Reduce motion
anim.reduceMotion.description: Skip motion; render the final static card.

anim.introFrac.label: Intro length
anim.introFrac.description: Share of the clip the intro fills (the rest holds).

anim.renderMode.label: Render mode
anim.renderMode.description: light (default) = the year unfolds week by week under one curtain — free; premium = every cell fades in on the diagonal, ~10× the render time.

anim.label: Animation
anim.description: Reveal: the calendar unfolds week by week (light) or fades in on the diagonal (premium). reduceMotion renders the final frame.
